name: What is the typical cost range for making a website AI-Ready?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for making a website AI-Ready?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to make a website AI-Ready varies significantly based on the existing website's complexity, its current technological stack, and the specific AI functionalities desired. Basic optimizations for AI compatibility might range from a few thousand dollars, while comprehensive overhauls integrating advanced AI features for personalization, chatbots, or complex analytics could extend into tens of thousands or more. A detailed audit is usually required for an accurate quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on current website complexity and desired AI features, ranging from a few thousand for basic optimization to tens of thousands for advanced integration.
